KEN.note: A National Cybersecurity Policy and Strategy is only being developed; no adopted strategy, body or incident is stated.

facts.fact: Principal Secretary Stephen Isaboke says the government continues, through the Universal Service Fund, to support connectivity expansion in underserved areas with mobile coverage gaps, and asks counties to name priority unconnected wards for targeted interventions.

systems.owner: State Department for Broadcasting and Telecommunications

KEN.note: The Digital Master Plan is named only as due for mid-term review; its adoption is not stated. The Digital Public Infrastructure Roadmap is a draft.
No budget amount, law or fund account is given; the Universal Service Fund is mentioned without money.
Only a target for ward digital hubs to give access to government online services; no service is stated online.
The backbone is named only as something to be monitored; no works, service or reach is stated.
No ICT sector policy is stated; the National Communication Policy is about government communication.
No county office connection is described; hubs and Wi-Fi are for the public.
